monsters.name: Sand Wolf

monsters.name: Alcyone

monsters.name: Zu
monsters.reason: Defensive mantle, sand pressure and ally ward; exclude Mirage because its native flight/landing rotation is staged.

monsters.name: Sand Worm
monsters.reason: Drain and area sand pressure; exclude replay of swallowing, regurgitation and terminal actions.

monsters.name: Mushussu
monsters.reason: Native physical/status dragon; one native replay or drain, with hostile Silence control rather than an ally heal.

monsters.name: Mech Guard
monsters.reason: Native gun action can replay; armor/ally support and sand shrapnel, without organic drain.

monsters.name: Mech Gunner
monsters.reason: Native ranged action can replay; defense and area shards, without organic drain.

monsters.name: Cactuar
monsters.reason: Mantle/sand pressure only; exclude Mirage to avoid duplicating fixed needles or the escape route.

monsters.name: Shred
monsters.reason: Defensive ally veil and single physical pressure; no caster chorus.

monsters.name: Skoll
monsters.reason: Pack attacks, blindside and same-target tempo punish fit its physical native action.

monsters.name: Flame Flan
monsters.reason: Arcane pressure, ally veil and magic Silence; exclude physical pack signature.

monsters.name: Nebiros
monsters.reason: Single physical/status pressure and tempo control, without caster-exclusive pressure.

monsters.name: Chimera Brain
monsters.reason: Native mixed spells and breath support arcane/defensive/silence variants.

monsters.name: Coeurl
monsters.reason: Both native spell and physical/status routes; permit either hybrid pressure or same-target control.

monsters.name: Ogre

monsters.name: Malboro

monsters.name: Epaaj

monsters.name: Mech Scouter

monsters.name: Mech Leader
monsters.reason: Physical pack support and tempo pressure; excludes creature-specific signatures.

monsters.name: Yowie
monsters.reason: Defensive veil, haste support and tempo control for its agile physical/status route.

monsters.name: Nidhogg

monsters.name: Dark Element

monsters.name: Epaaj

monsters.name: Thorn

monsters.name: Ghost

monsters.name: Machina Impaler

monsters.name: Imp

monsters.name: Mech Defender

monsters.name: Grendel

monsters.name: Ahriman

monsters.name: Behemoth
monsters.reason: Native mixed heavy attacks and magic support the T5/T6 hybrid pool; no aquatic-only skill.

monsters.name: Maelspike

monsters.name: Achelous
